defects.what: City-select field has no visible affordance (no chevron/caret or other tap indicator) — it reads as static text on a grey pill, not as a control that opens a bottom sheet
defects.where: City field 'Your city — select one', lower third of the screen

defects.what: 'Skip' link appears in a light grey that likely falls below WCAG AA 4.5:1 on white (~2.8–3.2:1 estimated)
Pagination dots use black for the active state; the design law reserves teal for selected/live states
defects.where: Progress dots between caption and city field

measured_notes: City pill measures ~48px tall; CTA pill ~56px — both meet/exceed the 44px minimum
Visual order observed: art → 'Turn confirmed' → caption → dots → city field → CTA; pagination dots are inserted between caption and city field, slightly breaking the contracted order
Large empty gap (~180–200px) between art block and title; no crowding between city field and CTA (~12–16px gap)
No truncation/ellipsis seen on title, caption, or city label
Title 'Turn confirmed' is near-black on white, high contrast; caption dark grey on white appears ≥4.5:1
non_blocking_notes: Layout is calm and uncluttered; single accent use (teal ring in the illustration) is consistent with restraint law
Screen gutters look consistent at ~16px on both sides; card/pill radii consistent between city field and CTA
Copy is honest and decision-supporting (no fabricated numbers)
one_line: Quiet, well-spaced decision slide that fails only on affordance details: the city field gives no visual cue that it opens a sheet, Skip is too light, and the active dot is black instead of teal.
